{{Quote|I've got a younger sister: Mata. She's a biologist. Like our mother was.|Wo Kasto|<ref name="Ear to the Water" />}}
'''Mata''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Biologist/Legends|biologist]] and the younger sister of [[Wo Kasto]].<ref name="Ear to the Water" /> Around [[3625 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.1}}</ref> Mata joined the [[Selkath Isolationists]] following the [[Invasion of Manaan]] and the [[Death/Legends|death]] of her [[Wo Kasto's mother|mother]] at the hands of [[Krallet Division]]. However, she left the group a few weeks before the [[Ambush in the Temple of the Progenitor|ambush]] in the [[Temple of the Progenitor]] and had been in hiding ever since.<ref name="Retribution in the Rift">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=faction|Republic|Retribution in the Rift|[[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]}}</ref> Wo Kasto later introduced Mata into the [[Manaan Incorporation Project]], leading her to encounter the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] diplomat [[Minn Ishkah]]. Kasto soon expressed his disapproval over a budding relationship forming between Mata and Ishkah.<ref name="Mail" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Mata was first mentioned in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] mission "Ear to the Water," in the Manaan Daily Area introduced in Game Update 7.1: ''Digging Deeper'', released on [[August 2]], [[2022]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Digging Deeper">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20220802|text=Game Update 7.1 "Digging Deeper" is live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
